oncall-bot: pager #3456 (embeddings-autoscaler/us-west-2) triggered 2026-03-17T18:02:01Z -> severity: P2. Brief: autoscaler bouncing nodes causing transient embed p95 spikes and periodic 503s to a small subset of customers. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-autoscaler

Maria Gonzales: quick summary from my shift — saw the initial page at 18:02. Root cause looks like a config flapping bug in the autoscaler that caused a scaling loop when spot reclaim events coincided with our warm-up probe. Affected pool: ew-embeds-usw-gpu-pool-3 (20% of traffic routed there).

Sam Lee: saw the 503s in the customer dashboard, spike lasted ~7m, then fell once we pinned desired replicas and disabled the aggressive warm-up probe. Customer impact: a handful of requests from two customers retried successfully; SLOs not breached but cosmetic errors. Notified support to flag any escalations. :white_check_mark:

Alex Patel: actions I ran while shadowing Maria:
```
# pin pool to stable count
kubectl patch hpa embeds-autoscaler -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":5,"maxReplicas":10}}'
# disable warmup probe temporarily
kubectl patch deployment embeds-worker -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"worker","livenessProbe":null}]}}}}'
```
Logs show repeated `scale up -> node preempted -> scale down -> scale up` loop at 18:01:55-18:09:00.

Priya Nair: I've suppressed the noisy alert rule (embeds.autoscaler.loop) for 30m to avoid page storms while we monitor. I've left the pager channel notification enabled for regression. Putting a brief ticket for infra to check spot reclaim patterns in region.

Jo Park: handoff notes for incoming shift — current status: mitigated but unstable. What to watch:
- Monitor embed tail latency p95 (dash: /dashboards/embeddings/p95)
- Error rate for 503s (metric: embeds.http.5xx.rate)
- Autoscaler event stream for >3 scale events/min (alert suppressed but check manually)

Maria Gonzales: next steps (owners):
- Follow-up bug ticket to runtime team for probe/warmup logic: assigned to Alex (ticket ID: ENG-7881).
- Infra to correlate spot reclaim timing with our AZs: assigned to Priya.
- Customer comms: Sam to confirm no open escalations and update support thread.
- Postmortem: I'll draft initial timeline and share by EOD; include logs and commands run.

Sam Lee: confirmed support thread updated, no active escalations, two customers had retries auto-succeed. I'll add a note if any follow-ups required.

Priya Nair: scheduled a short config rollback window at 19:10 UTC if instability reappears; otherwise we'll push a safe warmup probe fix tomorrow.

Maria Gonzales: handing primary to Priya at 19:00 UTC. Sam remains secondary for the next 2 hours. If anything regresses before handoff, ping me directly. Handoff checklist done: dashboards pinned, alerts noted, runbook link in thread. :handshake:
